== Published English Original Virtual Set 8 wording ==
The 30 March announcement adds one driver to the surviving original wording. The full remaster retains the driver and eight passengers, drops the alien discount, names the deploy phase for the single aboard pull, and sets attrition immunity below 6 instead of depending on Passenger Deck.
